description:
### Release v3.16.0

- **Gboard 18.5.4 Beta Compatibility**: Full support and targeting for Gboard `18.5.4.993608717-beta-arm64-v8a`
- **Universal Target Admission**: Verified core view bindings (`SoftKeyView`, `SoftKeyboardView`, `EmojiView`, `AutoCenterScaleTextView`) on Gboard 18.5.4
- **Signature Bypass & Package Rename**: Extended multi-version compatibility across 18.0.3 and 18.5.4
- **Dual-Track Target Stability**: Preserves all 43 flagship patches on 18.0.3 while admitting 18.5.4 for Morphe Manager patch workflow
